subtopic: Checking Adviser Backgrounds and Disciplinary History
source_evidence: Before opening an account with any financial professional, you should always remember to check the individual or entity’s background and disciplinary history.
answer: Before opening an investment advisory account, check the adviser’s background and disciplinary history. The source says you can use the free search tool at Investor.gov to do this. Checking both the individual adviser and the advisory firm can help you review their histories before deciding whether to open an account.
